_maintenance.purpose: FILE-LEVEL MAINTENANCE NOTE. This manifest indexes redistributable offline materials; the reserved field is valid JSON metadata rather than a non-standard comment.
update_checklist: Add or remove manifest items whenever bundled articles, documents, images or videos change.
Keep type, relative path, source/licensing metadata and sha256 synchronized with the actual file.
Never point outside the repository or index a missing/empty file.
Keep content_version and audit_date current for meaningful archive releases.
Run python "Offline Survival Project.py" --validate before committing.
